note: Written from validation results only, before any session-2 data was scored.
primary_analysis: session-2 trials without expert artifact flags; metrics averaged over seeds within each participant, then summarized over the nine participants
secondary_analysis: the same models scored on all session-2 trials, flagged ones included

comparisons.redundancy_vs_relevance: proposed-K minus relevance-K, K in (16, 8), FP32 and INT8
comparisons.redundancy_vs_weightnorm: proposed-K minus weightnorm-K, K in (16, 8), FP32 and INT8
comparisons.redundancy_vs_random: proposed-K minus the mean of random1-3-K, K in (16, 8), FP32 and INT8
comparisons.vs_full: every condition minus full-22 FP32; count participants losing more than 2 points
comparisons.quantization: INT8 minus FP32 for every condition
comparisons.pruning: pruned minus unpruned base, FP32 and INT8

uncertainty.method: participant-level bootstrap of paired differences, percentile interval
